flags.why: Ẩn náu describes hiding in a concealed refuge, so ordinary sheltering from rain under eaves does not illustrate this sense ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/%E1%BA%A8n_n%C3%A1u)).
flags.fix: Tên trộm ẩn náu trong một ngôi nhà bỏ hoang. = The thief hid out in an abandoned house.

flags.why: The common meaning of showing someone how to do something, as in bày cách, is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%A0y)).
flags.fix: verb | to show someone how; to instruct

flags.why: The everyday meaning of devising or initiating something, as in bày trò, is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%A0y)).
flags.fix: verb | to devise; to come up with (a plan, trick or activity)

flags.why: The common use in chớp lấy cơ hội means to seize an opportunity and is not covered by the listed meanings.
flags.fix: verb | to seize; to grab (an opportunity)

flags.why: Everyday expressions such as tay lái còn yếu refer to driving ability rather than the steering equipment.
flags.fix: noun | driving skill; ability to control a vehicle

flags.why: Thuận means following the normal or specified direction, while clockwise comes from chiều kim đồng hồ and rightward is not inherent in thuận ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/thu%E1%BA%ADn)).
flags.fix: following the normal or specified direction; in the same direction as

flags.why: The directional use illustrated by thuận chiều kim đồng hồ is ordinary current Vietnamese, so rare is misleading ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/thu%E1%BA%ADn)).
